verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe shows WezTerm working headlessly: `wezterm-mux-server --daemonize` plus `wezterm cli spawn/send-text/get-text/list` ran with no GUI session. The docs confirm the cli subcommand drives a multiplexer instance and that config values can be overridden on the command line. CI use itself is not documented, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: first-party docs on headless/CI operation, documented CI recipes or exit-code/automation guidance, independent community corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
